candidates.title: SCORPIO: Serving the Right Requests at the Right Time for Heterogeneous SLOs in LLM Inference
candidates.reason: SLO-oriented serving system combining deadline-aware reordering/rejection, VBS-based admission control, credit-based batching and prediction; reports up to 14.4x goodput and 46.5% higher SLO adherence.

candidates.title: AugServe: Adaptive Request Scheduling for Augmented Large Language Model Inference Serving
candidates.reason: Adaptive two-stage scheduling and dynamic token batching for tool-augmented LLM requests; reports 4.7-33.1x higher effective throughput than vLLM and up to 96.3% TTFT reduction.

candidates.title: FairBatching: Fairness-Aware Batch Formation for LLM Inference
candidates.reason: Fair prefill/decode batch formation with adaptive capacity and load estimation; realistic-trace evaluation reports up to 2.29x lower TTFT tail latency, 20% higher single-node capacity and 54.3% higher cluster capacity while maintaining TPOT SLOs.
